title: WIT SynApps Runtime through 1.4.11 contains a browser-mediated cross-origin request forgery vulnerability that allows…
description: WIT SynApps Runtime versions through 1.4.11 have a cross-origin request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability that allows attackers to manipulate the victim's browser to send discovery requests to attacker-controlled hosts during controller onboarding. This can be used to probe internal network resources and cross IT/OT segmentation boundaries via a legitimate application path.
